paragraphs: Early in the morning, review the day's service schedule and prepare the room. When the family arrives, guide check-in, offer white flowers, and quietly explain the process. Stay nearby throughout the ceremony to assist as needed. Afterward, clear and disinfect the room, restore everything to place, and prepare for the next service.
